episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the importance of consistent client communication to prevent lost deals and the role of AI in real estate. While AI can enhance efficiency, personal connections remain crucial. The conversation also covers how team leaders can leverage AI and systems to improve productivity without losing the human touch.
